function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies the customer's identity before any debt information can be disclosed. MUST be called after greeting.

dob.description: The customer's date of birth in DD-MM-YYYY format.

mobileLast4.description: The last 4 digits of the customer's registered mobile number.

function.name: get_account_details
function.description: Retrieves the customer's loan details. Will fail with AUTH_REQUIRED if verify_customer has not succeeded first.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs a promise to pay (PTP) when the customer commits to making a payment.

ptpDate.description: The date the customer promised to pay (e.g., '15-Aug-2026').

ptpAmount.description: The amount the customer promised to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Sends a payment link to the customer via SMS or WhatsApp.

channel.description: The channel to send the link through.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Initiates a warm transfer to a human agent. Use this for disputes, hostilily, or 3 failed auth attempts.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final outcome of the call. ALWAYS call this before ending the conversation.

dispositionCode.description: The categorical outcome of the call.

notes.description: Optional brief notes about the call outcome.
